title: Court Filing: US Commerce Department Pressured Intel for 10% Stake
summary: Court filings show that in August 2025 a U.S. Commerce Department lawyer told Intel’s CFO the board could reject a demand for a 10% equity stake but warned of unpredictable consequences; days later Intel’s board transferred the shares, and President Trump said the government paid nothing for a stake now worth about $11 billion.

references.title: Trump Administration Is Snapping Up Stakes in Private Companies.
Intel will give the U . S . government a 10% stake , Trump says : NPR
